description: Houston, TX–Today, Congresswoman Lizzie Fletcher (TX-07) launched her first digital ad of the 2026 general election cycle, “Costs.” The 30- and 15-second cuts will run on YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and streaming platforms through Election Day, November 3, as part of a six-figure investment to help elect Democrats up and down the ballot.

title: Congresswoman Lizzie Fletcher Releases First Ad of 2026 Highlighting Rising Costs Under Donald Trump, Republicans – Lizzie Pannill Fletcher | U.S. Congress | Texas 7th Congressional District
